name: Infernal drops its summon spell at the target point (#13116)
contract: Infernal 560284 effect 2 triggers 572183, the summon of Infernal 51320. 572183 carries the falling missile (Speed 100, SpellVisual 832635); 560284 itself has Speed 0.
The trigger targets enemies in the area, so it stays disabled and the server casts 572183 at the chosen point instead: the cast must reach the client exactly once, with no enemy in the area.
The summon must still produce exactly one Infernal.
